comment: Dr. Annesley was so lovely and I absolutely adored her class. Most of the grade comes from 3 papers, but they are fairly straightforward and she is always available to meet and discuss ideas with you. Super understanding and willing to work with you! Also very funny and made lectures and discussions super interesting. Highly recommend her!

"Dr. Annesley is an outstanding professor. She is incredibly understanding of students' time and is very reasonable to work with. Philosophy is entirely unrelated to my major, but I went out of my way to take a second class she taught because I enjoyed the first so much. Cannot recommend enough. Make sure to do the readings/informal assignments.

Really good introductory ethics course. Classes are all discussion based and allow for a lot of participation. Lots of freedom given with essays, and all writing for this class is very short. For the midterm and final you can use a cheat sheet. Dr. Annesley is super helpful and definitely cares about her students.

I love prof Kelley! She is very helpful during office hours and her classes are a good mix of lecture and discussion. You get a cheat sheet during exams which is very helpful. Would definitely recommend as long as you're comfortable talking in class/sharing your opinions.

Kelley is a very understanding teacher especially for an english class. Fair grading, willing to meet and provide good feedback, and only gives 2 papers that are relatively short. Homework is based on completion but make sure to participate in class atleast once or twice. Exams are based on in class discussions and follow the study guide closely.

Annesley is an amazing Prof. and truly inspirational. She is the reason I am a PHIL major. Her lectures are super interesting and insightful. I had her in back to back classes and did not get bored what so ever. Her exams have cheat sheets and she grades super fair on essays. Highly recommend!
